note: Delphi Epidata (CMU): five daily COVID-19 signals for US states, each from a different upstream publisher.
title: Delphi Epidata COVID-19 signals (US states)
description: Daily values per US state and territory for five signals Delphi distributes: hospital admissions (HHS), confirmed cases (JHU CSSE), outpatient COVID-like illness (doctor visits), symptom searches (Google) and the symptom survey (Facebook/CMU). Each upstream publisher is its own source with its own publication lag (rule T-LAG). The stored value is Delphi's latest revision; its issue date is kept as an attribute.

sources.title: HHS confirmed COVID-19 admissions via Delphi
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus 5 days (basis proxy_publication_lag)

sources.title: JHU CSSE confirmed cases via Delphi
sources.publisher: Johns Hopkins CSSE (via Delphi Epidata CMU)
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus 1 day (basis proxy_publication_lag)

sources.title: Outpatient COVID-like illness via Delphi
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus 5 days (basis proxy_publication_lag)

sources.title: Google symptom searches via Delphi
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus 4 days (basis proxy_publication_lag)

sources.title: COVID-19 Trends and Impact Survey via Delphi
sources.known_at_rule: Day of the value plus 1 day (basis proxy_publication_lag)
